contents.name: Corollary 1.33: minima and maxima of two L-integrable functions are L-integrable
contents.reason: The lattice closure of the L-integrable subclass depends on its absolute-integrability theory and belongs with the planned identification of that subclass with Lebesgue integrability.

contents.name: Corollary 1.34: L-integrability is equivalent to integrability of the positive and negative parts
contents.reason: The positive-and-negative-parts characterization is part of the Lebesgue comparison machinery rather than the compact gauge-integral spine developed at this reading-order position.

contents.name: Theorem 1.38: dominated convergence between two integrable bounding functions
